mapper.select: SELECT product_subscription_id, member_id, product_id, segment_id, subscription_role, term_months, start_date, maturity_date, expected_applied_rate, monthly_payment_limit_snapshot, initial_principal, status, maturity_amount, created_at FROM product_subscription WHERE segment_id = #{segmentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_subscription (member_id, product_id, segment_id, subscription_role, term_months, start_date, maturity_date, expected_applied_rate, monthly_payment_limit_snapshot, initial_principal) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{productId}, #{segmentId}, #{subscriptionRole}, #{termMonths}, #{startDate}, #{maturityDate}, #{expectedAppliedRate}, #{monthlyPaymentLimitSnapshot}, #{initialPrincipal})
